newsitem.title: USA: S3 sees higher rev growth in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: S3 sees higher rev growth in 2nd half.

text.p: S3 Inc said Monday it expects to return to double digit growth in quarterly revenues in the second half of the year.

"This growth will be fueled by the continuing ramp of our products in the corporate desktop and mobile market, along with the further acceptance of our audio offerings," the company said in a statement. "In addition, pricing appears to be returning to a more normalized environment and we expect to see the traditional rise in demand during the third quarter."

S3 reported net income for the just-completed second quarter was $2.3 million, or $0.05 per share, compared to net income for the same quarter last year of $8.8 million, or $0.18 per share. Revenues for the second quarter of 1997 were $108.9 million, up from $103.8 million for the second quarter of 1996.
